# Email Reciever — full context for LLMs

## What this site is

Email Reciever is an automated reading pipeline for technical newsletters. A
Cloudflare Worker receives email / RSS / archive-page content, slices the
relevant part with a per-source adapter, translates it into Simplified Chinese
with a provider chain (MyMemory keyless API → Workers AI → Google gtx), and
commits plain Markdown plus an index to a public GitHub repository. A TanStack
Start website reads that repository at request time (two-level cache) and
renders a filterable archive plus per-post reading pages.

Repository: https://github.com/email-reciever/website
Live site: https://email-reciever-website.jiangjiangjiangxi.workers.dev

## Data model

Content file `content/{author}/{slug}.md`:
- `author`: lowercase whitelist key (the source).
- `slug`: UTC timestamp `YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm-ss_SSS`, unique and sortable.
- YAML frontmatter fields: title, description, author, subAuthor?, date (ISO
  8601), origin_url, origin_site?, email_recorder?, translated?, avatar?,
  banner?, source_hash? (hash of the source HTML, used by the reconcile cron).
- Body: Markdown. When `translated: true` it is Chinese; otherwise English.

Index `manifest.json`: `{ "posts": [{ author, slug, title, description?, date,
origin_url?, origin_site?, subAuthor?, avatar?, banner?, translated? }] }`,
sorted by date descending. This is the single source for the list page.

## URL map

- `/` — archive list. URL state: `?source=&q=&page=`.
- `/post/$author/$slug` — article page (mirrors the content path).
- `/subscribe` — how to subscribe + feed preview.
- `/rss.xml` — RSS 2.0 feed (latest 50 posts, ETag, 5-minute cache).
- `/sitemap.xml` — all post URLs with lastmod.
- `/llms.txt` — this index (short form).
- `/llms-full.txt` — full context (this file).

## Raw content access (no auth)

- Index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/email-reciever/website/main/manifest.json
- Post: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/email-reciever/website/main/content/{author}/{slug}.md
- Architecture: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/email-reciever/website/main/docs/architecture.md
- Design system: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/email-reciever/website/main/docs/design-system.md

## Scheduled jobs (worker crons)

- `0 */6 * * *` — newest-first sync of every RSS/archive source (one item each).
- `15 3 * * *` — backfill oldest missing items from feed history.
- `45 4 * * *` — reconcile existing posts: repair empty body / missing
  translation, and re-publish in place when the source HTML hash changed.

Each source runs in its own Worker invocation through a SELF service binding so
the free-plan subrequest budget is not exhausted.

## Translation provider chain

1. MyMemory (`api.mymemory.translated.net/get`), keyless, langpair `en|zh-CN`,
   ~420 characters per request, optional `de` email raises the daily quota.
2. Workers AI (`@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`) — 4,000 char chunks.
3. Google `gtx` — 1,200 char chunks (frequently 429 from datacenter IPs).

Every chunk is validated by comparing the multiset of `<P|line-col-offset/>`
code placeholders before and after translation. On total failure the original
text is stored with `translated: false`.

## Source categories

Frontend / web: astro, cloudflareblog, csstricks, frontendfocus, javascriptweekly,
nodeweekly, reactdigest, reactstatus, smashingmag, svelte, typescript, tyler,
syntaxfm, alexkondov, arcupdate, insidergithub, mediumcom, modular, producthunt,
rnn, others.
AI: awsml, garymarcus, importai, mittechai.
Chinese: ajiang, zhihu.

## Citing this site

Prefer the raw GitHub URLs above; they are stable, versioned and require no
JavaScript. Include the post `author/slug` and the `date` from frontmatter.
